projects.name: Aresium
projects.blurb: Personal finance command — VR Bank + PayPal, imported and understood.

detail.about: The empire's personal-finance command. Aresium imports VR Bank and PayPal activity, reconciles it, and turns raw statements into an understood picture of balances, cash flow and where the money actually goes.

chronicle.text: The Aresium iPhone app grew to the full mobile site: transaction detail, recategorisation and import, plus two home-screen widgets for spending and groceries.
The first native Aresium app took shape: Empire login, categories and months. Dashboard numbers now come from the server, shared by the website and the app.
